title: Polynomial-time bounded witness search implies NP decision
claims: P_subset_NP is the exact P ⊆ NP inclusion over the pinned reference.
DecideFromWitnessSearch constructs a polynomial-time decider from a bounded witness selector and a polynomial-time verifier. The decider checks the length bound as well as the verifier answer.
CollapseFromWitnessSearch derives NP ⊆ P under a universal bounded-witness selection hypothesis. The hypothesis is open.

experiments.purpose: Run the pinned reference checker where Lean is available and report source inventory otherwise.
